message: 会いたい時に君はいない
I came to school even before the gates opened,
and held out right until morning Student Council activities started, but...

name: Synn
message: 「Morning.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! I just went and asked Melilot-san, and she said Azel didn't stay over!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」
Even though Azel told me on the phone yesterday that she was staying at Melilot-san's place...

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun! Don't you have any idea where she might be?」

name: Synn
message: 「If I did, I'd already be looking for her.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san spent the night in a convenience store parking lot.」

name: Ria
message: 「Wouldn't that be pretty cold this time of year?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai―san. It is an established rule that boys and girls with nowhere to go spend the night in convenience store parking lots―」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let me guess, it was written in your guidebook.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. They broadcast it on TV. My guidebook stated that they spend the night in empty-tub boxes, so that information is likely outdated.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Both of those are wrong.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Right? I thought it sounded strange. An empty tub and a box are both containers, after all. It's like falling off a horse and taking a tumble from your steed.」

name: Ria
message: 「Has she not come to the classroom either? If not, I'll contact Big Sis.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In that case, I'll be the one to contact Senpai.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'll do it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, you don't even have a cell phone, do you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel's not here...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then let's have Ria―senpai―」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mornin'~ You all look pretty serious so early in the morning~」

name: Eddie
message: 「Is it a lover's quarrel?! You lucky dog!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahh, so that's what's going on~」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not it. Hey, have you seen Azel around」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I saw her. She was taking photos at the entrance this morning」

name: Synn
message: 「What!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You must've mistaken her for someone else」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's mean, Nana-chan. Even I probably remember my own classmates' faces」

name: Eddie
message: 「I saw her too. She was sitting at the edge of the field for a while during morning practice」

name: Eddie
message: 「C-Could it be she's got a thing for me!? A love triangle with my best friend!? I'm fired up!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Idiot」
So she is coming to school...

name: Shio
message: 「If it is Lady Azel you seek, I spotted her during break just a moment ago」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Where!!」

name: Shio
message: 「She was walking toward the old school building――」
The Student Council room!

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」
She's gone.
There's no doubt about it--she's avoiding me.
But why?
Did she go back to how she was when she first transferred here?
No, if that were it, Azel would blatantly ignore us. There's no way she'd run away.
She wouldn't even show her face at the academy.
What was Azel doing in here during class hours?
I booted up the laptop.
I open the folder storing the data Azel took.
There were several new image files inside.

name: Paqy
message: 「Aze-ko was transferrin' data」

name: Synn
message: 「So she learned how to do it」
They're all completely ordinary photos of academy life.
Judging by the dates, she seems to have taken them after she started avoiding me.
Did she come all the way here just to transfer the data.

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be」
I checked the last modified date of the folder containing the photos Azel had handpicked for the Holy Night Festival exhibit.
Sure enough, it was just moments ago.

name: Synn
message: 「So he was choosing the photos to display at the Holy Night Festival……」

name: Paqy
message: 「If we could see inside, there might be a clue」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know the password」
Come to think of it, since Azel was the one selecting the photos himself, he should've been able to transfer the data on his own too.
I'd assumed without any real basis that he couldn't do it just because he always had me do it for him.
So Azel was asking me to do things he was perfectly capable of doing himself.
Why?

name: Melilot
message: 「He hasn't come by today either」

name: Synn
message: 「I…… see」
Did he go home? I hope so.

name: Synn
message: 「Um. Yesterday, he really」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. He did not stay the night at my place」

name: Melilot
message: 「He likely didn't want to make you worry」

name: Synn
message: 「……If that's the case, he should just come home properly」
While serving me some black tea, Melilot-san said,

name: Melilot
message: 「There are times when one doesn't want to go home, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Have you had times like that?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm speaking in general terms」

name: Melilot
message: 「He went home. He did」

name: Azel
message: 「……Thanks」

name: Melilot
message: 「What were you doing yesterday?」

name: Azel
message: 「Sorry for using you as an excuse」

name: Melilot
message: 「There are times when one feels the urge to tell a lie, you know」

name: Azel
message: 「You've had times like that?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm speaking in general terms」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, one piece of advice. If you are going to lie, you ought to get your stories straight」

name: Melilot
message: 「So, what are you going to do today?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I don't think you can keep running away like this, you know」

name: Azel
message: 「Yeah... I guess」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're gonna catch a cold standin' around out here forever. Let's head back」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, evening, Prez」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Evening」
Eauderourke was holding a large bag.
Judging by the smell, it seemed to be stuffed full of beef bowls.

name: Synn
message: 「Evening」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Prez, what wrong? Here, stand long, catch cold」

name: Paqy
message: 「See, even this guy's sayin' it」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey. Have you two seen Azel around?」

name: Sally
message: 「I haven't seen her today」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Azel. That, Prez, together, worry for Ode, woman?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, saw」

name: Synn
message: 「Where!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「This morning, Ode, jogging, front of Prez's apartment, from inside, come out. Saw」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」
Coming out from inside means she'd snuck back home!

name: Paqy
message: 「You go jogging and shit?」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Jogging, good for body. Food, taste better. Ode, happy」

name: Synn
message: 「Around what time?」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, saw, morning, around 6」
She'd snuck back in and snuck back out. That made me feel a little relieved.

name: Synn
message: 「Did you notice any noises or anything, Sally-chan?」

name: Sally
message: 「Six o'clock this morning is ancient history, I already forgot. I was sleeping soundly, too」

name: Paqy
message: 「Useless」

name: Synn
message: 「Coming from you, who's always sleeping soundly」

name: Soltia
message: 「What might you be doing this late at night?」

name: Azel
message: 「...What do you want」

name: Soltia
message: 「Just a final confirmation. It would be troublesome if you forgot to lure out Synn Sakura for me」

name: Soltia
message: 「Oh, excuse me. There was no need for that, was there? After all, God's will is your will」

name: Azel
message: 「...Shut up」

name: Soltia
message: 「What becomes of God's proxy if they defy God's will, I wonder? A fallen angel, perhaps? Though that could never happen to you」

name: Soltia
message: 「Well then, see you later」

name: Sally
message: 「Yaaawn... Prez, I'm going to bed first」

name: Synn
message: 「Good night」

name: Sally
message: 「G'niiight... yaaawn」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Lord Synn. Do you really think that Azel punk is gonna come back?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Paqy
message: 「Can't be helped. I'll keep you company」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yaaawn... Hey, Demon Lord. It's already midnight. Yaaaaawn...」

name: Synn
message: 「He'll come back」

name: Azel
message: 「...He's asleep」
A small figure slips into the dark entryway.
As I held my breath and watched as if I had become part of the darkness, the figure took off their shoes and headed toward the stairs without making a sound.
To Azel, standing frozen at the bottom of the stairs--

name: Synn
message: 「Welcome back」

name: Azel
message: 「I-idiot! Why are you awake!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I was waiting for you, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「Why!?」
The fact that Azel's face looked a little pale was probably just the lighting.

name: Synn
message: 「Because I wanted to see you」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm glad I got to see you」

name: Azel
message: 「I…… didn't want to see you or anything……」

name: Synn
message: 「There's a lot I want to talk to you about」

name: Synn
message: 「It's late tonight, so tomorrow works too, though」

name: Azel
message: 「Is this…… the Lord's will…… or a trial…… Does He know everything……」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「Now is fine. I'll go change」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, since we might wake Sally-chan up in my room. In the kitchen」

name: Azel
message: 「No」

name: Synn
message: 「No?」

name: Azel
message: 「I want to go for a walk」

name: Synn
message: 「It looks great on you」

name: Azel
message: 「Y-You think so?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're cute」

name: Azel
message: 「I-Idiot!」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean it」

name: Synn
message: 「You should wear it more often」

name: Azel
message: 「It's a hassle」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why did you wear it tonight?」

name: Azel
message: 「I just thought I'd wear it for once... There's no deep meaning behind it.」

name: Azel
message: 「But... you really think it's cute...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I really do.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's not like I care what you think anyway!」
Azel said curtly and quickened her pace.
I quickly caught up to walk beside her.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, have you been eating properly for the past three days?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's none of your business.」

name: Synn
message: 「As long as you've been eating properly, that's fine. It's just that I have this image of you eating nothing but Vandine Jelly if left alone.」

name: Azel
message: 「What kind of person do you take me for?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you were like that right after we first met.」

name: Azel
message: 「...I suppose I was.」

name: Synn
message: 「Things changed after we went to get ramen, didn't they?」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go eat at Five-Star Hanten again sometime.」

name: Azel
message: 「Really?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Azel
message: 「A-Ahem. Not that... I care about ramen or anything...」
Figuring out how to come up with the money is the problem, but I definitely have to take her there.

name: Synn
message: 「Next time, I'll treat you to a different kind of ramen.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Hold on. Don't you have no money, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't worry about it.」

name: Azel
message: 「I do worry. I'll pay for my own share.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I'm the one who brought it up.」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't hold back.」
Wait, this isn't the time to be talking about ramen!
There's something much more important.

name: Synn
message: 「Putting the ramen aside for now,」

name: Azel
message: 「It is important.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's something I want to talk to you about.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, well...」
When it actually comes time to speak, I can't quite find the right way to bring it up.
Pull yourself together, Student Council President!

name: Azel
message: 「...In the past, things like flavor did not matter to me at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, yeah. That's right, wasn't it?」

name: Azel
message: 「As long as I could take in the exact nutrients I needed without excess or deficiency, that was enough, and yet... I have grown corrupt.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't be so dramatic. I mean, I feel like I heard somewhere that enjoying your meals is actually better for your health, too. Though even if it wasn't healthy, enjoying it is still better.」

name: Azel
message: 「Eating is merely nutritional replenishment.」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you still think that now?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, wait, never mind that. Forget about the ramen. What I wanted to talk about is--」

name: Azel
message: 「Last night. I was swimming in the pool. No, floating.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
For a split second I didn't understand what she meant, but,

name: Synn
message: 「Wait... did you use the pool without permission again!?」

name: Azel
message: 「No one saw me. There is no problem.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, there definitely is a problem.」

name: Azel
message: 「Ever since you saw me, I have been strict about concealing myself, and as a result, no problems have occurred.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Please get permission.」

name: Azel
message: 「Regarding the hours after the gates close, there is no rule stipulating the need for permission. I checked.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's only because nobody ever anticipated a situation like that.」

name: Azel
message: 「When I float, gravity disappears. There is no longer any need to support my body. I become light. That is why I liked floating in the pool.」

name: Synn
message: 「'Liked'? What about now, then?」

name: Azel
message: 「Gravity has not actually disappeared. It is merely being masked by buoyancy. Gravity continues to bind me down. I cannot escape this inconvenient body.」

name: Synn
message: 「I've never really felt restricted, though」
Oh, right.
Azel is an angel, after all.
I can't quite picture what a place like Heaven is really like, though--maybe it's a world where everyone flies around in the sky blowing trumpets.

name: Synn
message: 「Do you hate it?」

name: Azel
message: 「The sensation of water tickling my skin, the faint sound of water, even the smell of water mixed with chlorine--I have stopped hating all of them」

name: Synn
message: 「You sound like you wanted to keep hating them」

name: Azel
message: 「In the past, I hated everything about this world」
Azel suddenly stopped walking and looked at me.
Her face looked sorrowful.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?」
The dark shadows cast by the thickets of Tsukino-o Park behind where Azel stood faintly outlined her petite figure.
An unsettling sensation faintly resonating in the core of my head.
This feeling is... a barrier!?
Azel looked like she might burst into tears at any moment. She looked as though she were about to break.

name: Azel
message: 「I was supposed to hate this world」

name: Azel
message: 「I had to hate it!」
Suddenly, Azel broke into a run, pulling away.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!? Wait!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel! Where are you!?」
The unsettling sensation ringing sharply in the core of my head grew worse and worse.
I have a bad feeling about this.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel! Don't go that way!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」
As I ran, I tightly gripped the Rosary at my chest.
The chant to invoke the angel's protection surfaced in my mind.

name: Synn
message: 「He who guides the master, descending by the ancient covenant--Avanshell, Angel of Pitch-Black Darkness!」
Spirit Power swirled around me, and I transformed on the run.

name: Azel
message: 「Why are you coming!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't just leave you alone. Because I--」

name: Azel
message: 「Synn!」
Azel looked behind me.
Sensing rapidly swelling mana and intense heat at my back,
I instinctively threw myself forward just as heat intense enough to scorch my hair passed right over my head.
Feeling several trees in the park burst into flames in an instant, I got up and turned around,
A chill ran down my spine.
A demon cloaked in mana as thick as the stagnant depths of the ocean. What's more, the strongest one yet.
Keeping my eyes forward, I called out.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, are you okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「Y-yeah」
